title: CLEAR TEST DRIVE WAIVER
description: Vehicle trials now explain handling limits, included cosmetics, refund rules, and what the showroom means by "race-ready" before the engine starts flirting with the wallet.
consequence: The showroom stops doing magic tricks with the keys.

title: DAYLIGHT SKIN PREVIEW
description: Weapon skins now preview under normal mission lighting, plain reload speed, and zero heroic smoke so players can see exactly how much dragon paint is actually on the rifle.
consequence: The weapon model meets daylight and loses its speechwriter.

title: CONFESSION ALTAR OFFER
description: After a boss death, the chapel now offers a limited revive blessing with solemn bells, gold-trimmed regret, and a countdown that pretends urgency is a sacrament.
consequence: The altar learns pressure sales in Latin.

title: FRAUD-PROOF MOUNT CHECKOUT
description: Mount purchases now require stable verification, faction address matching, saddle intent confirmation, and one armored security screen before the preview can move.
consequence: The checkout puts on plate armor and blocks the door.
